system.longDesc:
Cost: 2 SP

Infiltration stunts may apply when physically breaking in somewhere or exploring a new place, hacking into a computer or network, pulling a con job, or otherwise evading consequences and getting away with things.

Your flashy action makes you the center of attention. Each of your allies gains +1 to their next test to hide or pass scrutiny in this encounter, such as Dexterity (Legerdemain) or (Stealth) or Communication (Disguise). Any action an opponent takes until then automatically targets you.
